what: Post hoc (D36), not scored: ORegan2022, the coupled and single-unit models with two-way heat, 160 points along each particle's radius (uniform, both particles), beside the registered readings at PyBaMM's default 20 points (results/stage5_discharge.csv, stage5_shares.csv, stage5_charge.csv, stage5_limit.csv). Penalty = single-unit energy (capacity) to 2.5 V over the coupled model's, less one. Spread = time average of the largest minus the smallest group share; its error = the kernel's spread over the resolved kernel's, less one. Margin = minimum of the negative electrode's surface potential difference over the charge, the electrode and the groups.
